title: Free MMR Vaccine Clinic
summary_en: A free walk-in clinic offering MMR (measles, mumps, rubella) vaccines for kids and adults. No appointment needed.
summary_es: Una clínica gratuita sin cita que ofrece vacunas MMR (sarampión, paperas, rubéola) para niños y adultos.
how_students_can_help: Volunteer at the check-in table or help hand out bilingual info sheets.

title: Community Food Drive
summary_en: Help collect and sort food donations for local families ahead of Thanksgiving.
summary_es: Ayude a recolectar y clasificar donaciones de alimentos para familias locales antes del Día de Acción de Gracias.
how_students_can_help: Sign up for a 2 hour sorting shift with friends.

title: After-School Homework Help
summary_en: Weekly homework help for middle and high school students in math, reading, and science.
summary_es: Ayuda semanal con las tareas para estudiantes de secundaria en matemáticas, lectura y ciencias.
how_students_can_help: Lincoln students can tutor once a week in their strongest subject.

title: Lincoln x Oxford Community Game Day
summary_en: Board games, basketball, and food trucks open to Lincoln students and Oxford families.
summary_es: Juegos de mesa, baloncesto y camiones de comida abiertos a estudiantes de Lincoln y familias de Oxford.
how_students_can_help: Help run a game station or invite a family you met volunteering.
